text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bomb explosion kills two girls near Chrea, south of Algiers, as relatives bury villagers slaughtered by "terrorists" in the nearby area of Larba.
- Algeria attracts more western businessmen who broke with previous scepticism about the situation in the country.
- Security forces kill eight "terrorists" in Ksar Boukhari area, south of Algiers.
- Security forces kill "terrorist" and arrest three in Algiers.
- Vehicle assembly factory workers, angry over restructuring plans, hold protest gathering by the door of the company managers' offices in Rouiba, near Algiers.
- Cabinet meets to discuss the government programme which is widely inspired by President Liamine Zeroual's pledges during 1995 presidential election.
